name: StopLevelCounter
summary: This is a utility indicator that displays the profit/loss for a user-specified lot size at a draggable horizontal price level. It calculates and shows the potential profit for both buy and sell positions based on the distance between the current Bid/Ask and the user-placed stop level. It does not open, manage, or close any trades automatically.
summary_zh: 这是一个工具型指标，在图表上显示用户指定手数在可拖动水平价格线处的盈亏。它根据当前买价/卖价与用户放置的止损位之间的距离，计算并显示买入和卖出仓位的潜在利润。它不会自动开仓、管理或平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该程序实际上是一个辅助工具而非交易策略EA。它的核心概念是通过在图表上放置一条可拖动的水平线来模拟止损/止盈价位，然后实时计算在该价位平仓时的盈亏金额。入场条件和出场条件不适用于此工具，因为它不会自动执行任何交易。仓位管理方面，用户可以通过输入参数Lot来设定想要计算的手数，但工具本身不进行任何仓位操作。资金管理方面，工具调用OrderCalcProfit函数根据当前Bid/Ask价格和止损线价位计算买入和卖出的潜在利润，并将结果以账户货币显示在图表上。整体而言，这是一个纯信息展示工具，帮助交易者直观评估不同止损/止盈位的风险回报比。
strategy_analysis_en: This program is essentially a utility tool rather than a trading strategy EA. Its core concept is to place a draggable horizontal line on the chart to simulate a stop-loss or take-profit level, then calculate the profit or loss in real-time if the position were closed at that level. Entry and exit conditions do not apply since the tool does not automatically execute any trades. For position sizing, the user can specify the lot size via the Lot input parameter, but the tool itself does not manage any positions. For money management, the tool calls the OrderCalcProfit function to calculate the potential profit for both buy and sell positions based on the current Bid/Ask prices and the stop level line, displaying the results in the account currency on the chart. Overall, this is a pure information display tool that helps traders visually assess the risk-reward ratio at different stop-loss or take-profit levels.

pros: 直观的可视化盈亏展示，交易者可以拖动水平线快速评估不同价位的利润
同时显示买入和卖出两个方向的潜在利润，方便双向分析
使用定时器每秒更新数据，确保显示信息与市场实时同步
使用静态变量缓存旧值避免不必要的图表重绘，提高了性能效率
界面可自定义颜色、字体、位置等参数，用户体验灵活
pros_en: Intuitive visual profit/loss display — traders can drag the horizontal line to quickly evaluate profit at different price levels
Simultaneously shows potential profit for both buy and sell directions, enabling convenient bidirectional analysis
Uses a timer to update data every second, ensuring displayed information stays synchronized with the market in real-time
Employs static variables to cache old values and avoid unnecessary chart redraws, improving performance efficiency
Highly customizable interface with configurable colors, fonts, and positioning parameters for flexible user experience
cons: 没有任何交易功能，仅作为信息展示工具使用，功能较为单一
依赖于GetFontName.mqh外部包含文件，如果缺少该文件则无法编译
水平线初始放置在当前Bid价位，用户必须手动拖动才有实际意义，缺乏更智能的初始位置设置
没有考虑点差和手续费对实际盈亏的影响，OrderCalcProfit的计算可能与实际结果有偏差
OnTimer使用1秒间隔但在无行情变化时仍会触发函数调用，存在一定的资源浪费
cons_en: No trading functionality at all — it serves only as an information display tool with a relatively limited feature set
Depends on the external GetFontName.mqh include file; compilation will fail if this file is missing
The horizontal line is initially placed at the current Bid price, and the user must manually drag it for practical use, lacking a smarter default placement
Does not account for the impact of spread and commissions on actual profit/loss, so OrderCalcProfit calculations may deviate from real results
OnTimer uses a 1-second interval and triggers the function even when there are no market changes, resulting in some resource waste
improvements: 增加点差和手续费的显示，使盈亏计算更接近实际交易结果
添加多条水平线支持，允许用户同时比较多个不同止损/止盈位的风险回报比
improvements_en: Add spread and commission display to make profit/loss calculations closer to actual trading results
Add support for multiple horizontal lines, allowing users to simultaneously compare risk-reward ratios at different stop-loss or take-profit levels

risk_points: 该工具不会执行任何交易操作，因此不存在交易风险
作为辅助工具，其盈亏计算未包含点差和手续费，可能导致估算偏差
risk_points_en: This tool does not execute any trading operations, so there is no trading risk
As a utility tool, its profit/loss calculation does not include spread and commissions, which may lead to estimation deviations
